heroLead: Onekama sits on Portage Lake near Lake Michigan, and like a lot of resort towns in this county, the person who owns the cottage often isn't the one who owns what's underneath it.
intro: Onekama is a small village on Portage Lake in Manistee County, an area that's leaned heavily into tourism and cottage development for decades. The farm land further from the immediate shoreline has its own mineral history tied to Traverse Group and Michigan Basin oil and gas leasing, separate from the salt and brine history more associated with the city of Manistee itself.

sections.heading: Why split estate is so common around Onekama
paragraphs: As property near Portage Lake and the surrounding countryside turned into vacation homes and cottages over the decades, sellers often kept the mineral rights rather than passing them along with the surface. If you own a cottage near Onekama and have never received a royalty check, that's a common reason. If you're getting a check tied to land here that you don't own the surface of, that's the flip side of the same pattern.

sections.heading: What to check before assuming anything about value
paragraphs: Not every parcel near Onekama has an active oil and gas interest tied to it, and where one exists, it needs to be checked against current production, not assumed to match what a neighboring county's Antrim wells are doing. We pull your actual statements and recorded title before quoting anything.

sections.heading: What we need to evaluate an Onekama-area interest
paragraphs: Send your deed or probate document, any royalty statements or division orders you've received, and the legal description if you have it. Given how much of this area's land turned from farm to resort use, it helps to know when your family's property changed hands and whether the minerals moved with it.
We'll check the recorded chain of title alongside current production before saying anything definite about value.

faqs.question: I own a cottage on Portage Lake near Onekama. Do I own the minerals under it?
faqs.answer: Not necessarily. A lot of lakeside property in this area was sold with mineral rights reserved by a previous owner. Check your deed's mineral language to confirm.

faqs.question: Is Onekama part of the Antrim Shale trend?
faqs.answer: No, Manistee County sits outside the Antrim core. Any oil and gas history here is more tied to Traverse Group and other Michigan Basin formations.

faqs.question: How do I check the mineral title history for land near Onekama?
faqs.answer: The Manistee County register of deeds in the city of Manistee holds the recorded chain of title for the whole county, including the Onekama area.

faqs.question: Is a non-producing mineral interest near Onekama worth anything?
faqs.answer: It can carry some speculative value tied to future leasing potential, but that's a different situation from a producing royalty interest with real income history. We'll tell you plainly which one applies.
